message.content: {"pair_ids":["P2"],"evidence":"The original observations show a large, simultaneous jump in all three components (N, E, U) at index 572 (J1), which is followed by an opposite jump of similar magnitude at index 592 (J3). The hypothetical correction for pair P2, which subtracts the onset offset between these two points, successfully removes both discontinuities and restores continuity across all axes. In contrast, corrections for P1 and P3 fail to resolve the jumps consistently across all components."}
